name: markdown-outliner
description: Outliner for Markdown task lists, as an Obsidian plugin and a local web app.
author: hota911

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:plugin
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:node: node --test test/core.test.mjs test/inline.test.mjs test/keys.test.mjs test/three-way-merge.test.mjs test/server.test.mjs test/package-plugin.test.mjs test/version-bump.test.mjs test/changelog-section.test.mjs
scripts.test:obsidian: npm run build:plugin && playwright test --config obsidian-e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
